accessibility.previewScrolling: Labeled, focusable outer horizontal viewport and inner sidebar/dashboard vertical regions; static labels are not links, buttons, or disabled controls.

extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are generated display aids, not additional implementation tokens. Component HTML is illustrative and does not implement React behavior or downloads.

wms.presentation: Static source-based recreation with all 8 sidebar sections and 27 submenu entries expanded
wms.font: Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans, alias WMS Jakarta; 11px compact source dimensions, scoped to preview
wms.responsive: 1100px minimum desktop composition in a native horizontal viewport; 850px bounded shell with independent sidebar/dashboard vertical scrolling; hint at 1199px or below
wms.data: Fictional, visibly labeled dummy data; no backend connection
wms.interaction: No click actions, tooltips, forms, event listeners, observers, animation frames, or chart animations
wms.differences: Expanded groups; all permission/feature-gated labels shown; Sales Order presentation at dashboard end; fictional identity/dates/records; small dark-orange contrast adjustments
wms.verificationBoundary: Source templates/CSS inspected; no authenticated live WMS render or pixel-diff comparison. Implementation checks recorded in src/components/wms/README.md.

scrollTrail.lifecycle: Single on-demand RAF loop; cancels hidden, settled, unmounted; ResizeObserver and pageshow handle geometry/restoration

components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;height:78px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;background:var(--surface, #0B0D12);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #2A303B);color:var(--muted, #A0A8B7);}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav .ds-mark{font-size:25px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ink, #F4F5F7);}.ds-nav-items{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:14px;}.ds-nav-items a{position:relative;padding:12px 0;}.ds-nav-items a::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:5px;left:0;width:100%;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 180ms ease-out;}.ds-nav-items a:is(:hover,:focus-visible)::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-nav-items a:hover{color:var(--accent, #8BE9FD);}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #8BE9FD);outline-offset:6px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-items a::after{transition:none;}}
